GitHub workflow annotations, sticky comment and outputs of a capsule check

Source: R/capsule_check.R
ghann.Rd

Plain text for a GitHub Actions step, from a cpschk result: nothing here talks to GitHub, the caller prints or posts it. ghann() gives one workflow command per failed check, an ::error for an error row and a ::warning for a warn or drift row (notes give none), naming the file and, where the row has one, the line, with the data and properties escaped as GitHub requires. ghcmt() gives the body of a sticky pull-request comment: the marker line that finds it again, the Markdown report and a link to the run, cut to fit GitHub's 65,536-character limit. ghout() gives the step outputs of the rmbl action as a named list (print each as name=value to $GITHUB_OUTPUT).

Usage

ghann(x)

ghcmt(
  x,
  runurl = NULL,
  failon = NULL,
  marker = "<!-- rmbl-action -->",
  limit = 65000L
)

ghout(x, report = "", json = "", comment = "off")

Arguments

x

An rmbl_cpschk result.

runurl

Character scalar or NULL: the run's address, linked at the end of the comment.

failon

Character scalar or NULL: the fail-on level, named in the report's last line.

marker

Character scalar, the comment's first line (an HTML comment, invisible on GitHub).

limit

Integer: the longest body; a longer one is cut and says so.

report, json

Character scalars: the paths of the report and the JSON written, passed through as outputs.

comment

Character scalar: what became of the comment (off, dry-run, skipped, created, updated or failed), passed through.

Value

ghann(): a character vector, one line per annotation. ghcmt(): one string. ghout(): a named list with status, report, json, changed (the capsules whose source bytes changed, comma-separated), verified (capsules without an error), failed, manifest-changed ("true" or "false") and comment. Error: x is not a cpschk() result.

See also

cpschk.

Examples

root <- tempfile("capsules-")
d <- usecpstmpl(file.path(root, "one"), ex = TRUE)
invisible(cpsrfrsh(d))
p <- loadprov(file.path(d, "data_provenance.json"))
cat("1,2\n", file = file.path(d, p$resource$filename), append = TRUE)
x <- cpschk(root, fp = FALSE)
ghann(x)
#> [1] "::error file=/tmp/RtmpPCuyEb/capsules-20cb35f2f2c9/one/data_provenance.json,title=rmbl provenance data_sha256::expected 6b1a0d2d11f62eaffe4a95111286753aca9afc015fc4d0ea07c9953ff3030248, got e0061f4de8d524e9a8a421b502ae878a4de372a841e6bdf3ac3a5140b86682c8"
#> [2] "::error file=/tmp/RtmpPCuyEb/capsules-20cb35f2f2c9/one/data_provenance.json,title=rmbl provenance data_size_bytes::466 bytes on disk"                                                                                                                          
substr(ghcmt(x, runurl = "https://github.com/o/r/actions/runs/1"), 1, 80)
#> [1] "<!-- rmbl-action -->\n## rmbl capsule verify with [rmoriebricklayer 1.0.3](https:"
str(ghout(x, report = "rmbl-report.md", json = "rmbl-results.json"))
#> List of 8
#>  $ status          : chr "error"
#>  $ report          : chr "rmbl-report.md"
#>  $ json            : chr "rmbl-results.json"
#>  $ changed         : chr ""
#>  $ verified        : int 0
#>  $ failed          : int 1
#>  $ manifest-changed: chr "false"
#>  $ comment         : chr "off"

# one output per line, as $GITHUB_OUTPUT takes them
o <- ghout(x)
cat(sprintf("%s=%s\n", names(o), unlist(o)), sep = "")
#> status=error
#> report=
#> json=
#> changed=
#> verified=0
#> failed=1
#> manifest-changed=false
#> comment=off

try(ghann(list()))
#> Error : ghann: `x` must be a cpschk() result
